sources.fullCitation: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique. “Charles-Louis Pothier.” Musée SACEM, Les créateurs. Author, born at Bordeaux on 18 April 1881, died at Clichy on 3 November 1962; elected full member of SACEM on 17 February 1912; Prix Trebitsch, 1943; Prix Albert Willemetz, 1947; Prix Centenaire, 1950; Prix Célestin Joubert, 1956; Grand Prix de la Chanson, 1958. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: Charles-Louis Pothier
sources.researchNote: The list of society prizes, running from 1943 to 1958, documents a standing in the profession that the catalogue records do not show, and the register confirms the places of birth and death.
